doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Other Algiers dance bands: Tom's, Henry Allen, Kid Thomas, Edmund Payton
summary: Russell asks about other dance bands across the river. Martin says Tom's was the first; Henry Allen's father played only brass bands, and Kid Thomas and Jack Paeda played dances later. Tom recalls an earlier Edmund Payton band with a left-handed violinist.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Were there many other bands over there that played dances, like Buddy Johnson had a band I guess, and Deucin, any others over there much you can remember? Peter Boccage, I guess he had one at times.
Well, the only bands I remember back there when I was a kid over there was Tom.

Yeah, Tom of course was on the earliest there. But after that too, were there many other bands that came up? Well, the boys had scattered them. Yeah. What about Henry Allen, the old man, did he play dance jobs too or just brass bands?
I never saw him play dance. No, no. He never saw him. He never saw him. Just a brass band. Just a brass band. Yeah.
Of course I played with him there, he was on Passage Street, right?
Yeah. I played dance. You take Jack Paeda, Son, and Thomas. Yeah. Kid Thomas.
Kid Thomas. Kid Thomas. Yeah. He played them dance. That's getting down to my time now.

But they had another band after it. Before that, before we played that, Edmund Payton. And uh... Payton you say that? Edmund Payton. Edmund Payton. And uh... Boo Boo. Left hand... Bass player? Left hand violin player. Boo Boo, yeah. Yeah, Boo Boo. You know his real name, anybody? I don't know Boo Boo. And uh, who was playing uh... Uh... Some of them, I don't know who was playing uh... Playing bass with him. I don't know, but they had four.

You're a father. Yeah. Well that had, that was before. You understand? Then we come out with five pieces. Six pieces. Heisman used to have six pieces. Of course they didn't have no sax, they didn't have no drums, no piano. Yeah. And after a while they come and see you in the piano.
